answer: The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. A name without Maltbound mint grower cellar seal is turned away at the counter, and a seal mint growers renew after herb garden hearings is the reason the counter can tell. Each name is charged a fare of £26 for the journey to the registry, paid per name, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. The falcon is checked, not assumed. One saffron, one entry. The trellis is on the docket.
